en.shortDescription: Observability dashboards for metrics, logs, and traces
en.longDescription:
Grafana is an open source platform for monitoring and observability.

Visualize Prometheus metrics, logs, traces, and alerts in customizable dashboards. Admin credentials are set via SERVICE_USER_GRAFANA and SERVICE_PASSWORD_GRAFANA.

de.shortDescription: Observability-Dashboards für Metriken, Logs und Traces
de.longDescription:
Grafana ist eine Open-Source-Plattform für Monitoring und Observability.

Visualisiere Prometheus-Metriken, Logs, Traces und Alerts in anpassbaren Dashboards. Admin-Zugangsdaten werden über SERVICE_USER_GRAFANA und SERVICE_PASSWORD_GRAFANA gesetzt.

fr.shortDescription: Tableaux de bord d'observabilité pour métriques, logs et traces
fr.longDescription:
Grafana est une plateforme open source pour la supervision et l'observabilité.

Visualisez les métriques Prometheus, les logs, les traces et les alertes dans des tableaux de bord personnalisables. Les identifiants admin sont définis via SERVICE_USER_GRAFANA et SERVICE_PASSWORD_GRAFANA.

pt.shortDescription: Dashboards de observabilidade para métricas, logs e traces
pt.longDescription:
Grafana é uma plataforma open-source de monitoramento e observabilidade.

Visualize métricas do Prometheus, logs, traces e alertas em dashboards personalizáveis. As credenciais de administrador são definidas via SERVICE_USER_GRAFANA e SERVICE_PASSWORD_GRAFANA.
